email.body1:
Kelley, saw Phosphorus was named a 2026 SC Awards finalist and is joining Dragos to expand xIoT asset visibility.

Moments like an acquisition usually open more in-market accounts than the Northeast team can cover before things settle, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Phosphorus off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Kelley, quick follow-up for Phosphorus.

Through a transition, regional targets usually hold or climb while the team's attention is split. Most groups don't know exactly how many meetings it takes to hit the Northeast number, so the gap shows up late and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings your region needs this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Kelley, last bit of proof for Phosphorus.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Phosphorus's reply rate likely compares to other security software teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
email.body4:
Kelley, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling Northeast pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Timing matters most through a transition, and I know that stretch is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your region? I'll tailor it to Phosphorus either way.
